Game Overview

Pixelpool - 2 Player is a adventure title where guide the blue and red pixelpool characters through challenging obstacles as you race to the finish line. Jump, dodge, and strategize in this exciting two-player adventure. Cooperation and timing are key as you aim for victory. Can you both reach the door safely and claim triumph together?
